text: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196059 Act Number: 59 Enactment Date: 1960-12-26 Act Year: 1960 Short Title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 Long Title: An Act to prevent the infliction of unnecessary pain or suffering on animals and for that purpose to amend the law relating to the prevention of cruelty to animals. Department: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & DAIRYING DEPARTMENT Enforcement Date: 01-04-1961 Type: STATE Location: Haryana Notification: 1st April, 1961, vide Notification No.S.O.823, dated the 1st April, 1961, in respect of the State of Punjab and the Union territory of Andaman and Nicobar Island, see Gazette of India 1961, Part II,
